about.bio: Security product engineer at Infopercept Consulting. I build endpoint control, XDR pipelines and Rust agents: software whose job is to say no.
about.extra: Ahmedabad, India · saying no as a service
long: Anubhav Gain (mranv) is a security product engineer in Ahmedabad, India. He joined Infopercept Consulting in July 2024 as a security software engineer, building the Invinsense XDR deployment architecture, and since October 2026 has owned the technical direction of Invinsense Unified Endpoint Control. Through Infopercept he worked in Mumbai as an application security consultant at SBI Life (March to May 2026) and as an endpoint security consultant at Mahindra Finance (May to October 2026).

He also runs TechAnv Consulting, his own security research and consulting practice, started in December 2022. Before Infopercept he was a DevSecOps engineer at Atcults (November 2023 to July 2024) and an IT specialist at Parul University (November 2022 to October 2023). He holds a B.Tech in Cyber/Computer Forensics and Counterterrorism from Parul University (2021–2025) and two 2023 licentiates from Charles Sturt University, in Ransomware Techniques and Cybersecurity Management.

He maintains open-source security tools in Rust, Go and Python, including Leviathan, Atomic Prevention, Agni, Krustron and eBPF File Monitor, writes field notes on application control and detection engineering, and founded Gain Fisheries, a fish hatchery in Pakhanjur, Chhattisgarh, in August 2020.

projects.name: Leviathan
projects.desc: A Windows kernel-mode EDR/XDR framework written in Rust on windows-drivers-rs.
projects.long: Leviathan is a Windows kernel-mode driver framework in Rust. It registers process, thread, image, registry and object callbacks, runs a rule and behaviour engine mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, scans pool tags for memory forensics, detects hooks, supports ELAM, and streams telemetry to user mode over a lock-free ring buffer and ETW.

projects.name: Atomic Prevention
projects.desc: A prevention-focused living-off-the-land testing framework mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.
projects.long: Atomic Prevention flips Atomic Red Team: instead of testing detection, it tests whether preventative controls block living-off-the-land techniques. It ingests LOLBAS, LOLDrivers, LOLRMM and Atomic Red Team, maps them to ATT&CK techniques and adversary groups, generates a playbook per group, runs it with a PowerShell agent and reports what was blocked, detected or allowed.

projects.name: Agni
projects.desc: A CLI and web UI for running Firecracker microVMs, an alternative to firectl.
projects.long: Agni manages Firecracker microVMs from a command line and a web interface: create, start, stop and delete VMs, open a serial console, save configuration profiles and watch status and logs. Agni is Sanskrit for fire.

projects.name: Krustron
projects.desc: An open-source Devtron alternative: one dashboard for clusters, GitOps CI/CD and observability.
projects.long: Krustron is a Kubernetes-native platform that brings multi-cluster management, GitOps pipelines with ArgoCD, container scanning and policy enforcement, observability and fine-grained RBAC into a single dashboard.

projects.name: eBPF File Monitor
projects.desc: File monitoring for Linux in Rust, with inotify and eBPF and timestamped audit logs.
projects.long: ebpf-file-monitor tracks access, open, close, modify, create, delete, move and attribute events on a file, records the process, user and size change behind each one with millisecond timestamps, and writes text or JSON.

projects.name: Convoy
projects.desc: Your own autonomous system on one VPS, as a Docker Compose stack.
projects.long: Convoy runs BGP with RPKI route origin validation (BIRD 2, Routinator), an authoritative DNSSEC zone (NSD), a public NTP server with NTS (chrony), mail with DKIM and DANE (Postfix, Dovecot) and HTTP/3 (nginx) on one host. An offline lab runs 32 end-to-end checks before anything is deployed.

projects.name: vibe
projects.desc: A library of AI chat modes for software engineering, architecture and security analysis.
projects.long: vibe is an organised collection of system prompts and chat modes for engineering workflows.

projects.name: adPentest
projects.desc: Documentation for Windows Active Directory penetration testing.
projects.long: Notes and walkthroughs for Active Directory penetration testing.

projects.name: opensearch-rust-sdk
projects.desc: An OpenSearch Extensions SDK for Rust, built at Infopercept.
projects.long: An async Rust SDK for the OpenSearch Extensions API.

projects.name: osdls
projects.desc: Wazuh, Logstash, OpenSearch and OpenSearch Dashboards as one stack.
projects.long: Scripts that stand up Wazuh with Logstash, OpenSearch and OpenSearch Dashboards.

projects.name: appControlBusiness
projects.desc: Working notes on App Control for Business (WDAC).
projects.long: Policies, references and notes on Microsoft App Control for Business.

projects.name: tls.rs
projects.desc: A TCP client and server in Rust with TLS and real-time data transmission.
projects.long: A small Rust TCP client-server pair that streams data over TLS.

projects.name: linux.micrognu
projects.desc: A small GUI Linux distribution for QEMU, built from the kernel, BusyBox and Nano-X.
projects.long: A minimal Linux distribution with a GUI, assembled from the Linux kernel, BusyBox and Microwindows/Nano-X to run on QEMU.
